process postvisit.coding_review v1
Subject: case
Stages: [postvisit]
Start: read_note
Uses: [rule/postvisit.opportunities, rule/postvisit.assist_gate, rule/postvisit.suggestion_check]
Requires: [coding@1]
Variables: [{Name=case_ref, Type=Code, IsInput=true}, {Name=assist_enabled, Type=Boolean, IsInput=true}, {Name=items, Type=Integer, IsInput=false}, {Name=flagged, Type=Integer, IsInput=false}, {Name=opportunities, Type=Json, IsInput=false}, {Name=suggested_code, Type=Code, IsInput=false}, {Name=confidence, Type=Integer, IsInput=false}, {Name=suggestion_usable, Type=Boolean, IsInput=false}, {Name=final_code, Type=Code, IsInput=false}]
Scenarios: [the assistant is off and the physician approves, a usable suggestion is shown to the physician, who approves, an unsure suggestion is marked so, and the physician changes the code, the physician rejects the coding, an answer that breaks the output schema twice goes to the physician without a suggestion, an answer with a member the schema does not allow, every time, goes to the physician without a suggestion, an answer without a confidence goes to the physician without a verdict, an answer the rule cannot judge goes to the physician without a verdict, a transient failure of the assistant is retried, an assistant that fails goes to the physician without a suggestion, an assistant that is not available goes to the physician without a suggestion, a note that cannot be read still goes to the physician, a note that fails to read still goes to the physician, a read that is retried and then answers, a note without opportunities goes straight to the physician, a read without facts makes the rule fail and goes to the physician, a count the gate cannot judge goes to the physician, a practice that never said whether the assistant is enabled goes to the physician]
step read_note
  Kind: Read
  Stage: postvisit
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=find_opportunities}, {Label=onError, Target=physician_review}, {Label=onNotAvailable, Target=physician_review}]
  Port: records.note_facts
  Retry: {MaxAttempts=3, Backoff=exponential, Initial=00:00:30, Max=00:05:00}
  Inputs: [{Name=case, Variable=case_ref}]
  Outputs: [{Name=flagged, Variable=flagged}, {Name=items, Variable=items}]
  InputNames: [case_ref]
  OutputNames: [flagged, items]
step find_opportunities
  Kind: Decide
  Stage: postvisit
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=assist_gate}, {Label=onNoDecision, Target=physician_review}, {Label=onError, Target=physician_review}]
  Rule: postvisit.opportunities
  CollectInto: opportunities
  Facts: [{Name=flagged, Variable=flagged}, {Name=items, Variable=items}]
  InputNames: [flagged, items]
  OutputNames: [opportunities]
step assist_gate
  Kind: Decide
  Stage: postvisit
  Routes: [{Label=on:no, Target=physician_review}, {Label=on:yes, Target=suggest}, {Label=onNoDecision, Target=physician_review}, {Label=onError, Target=physician_review}]
  Rule: postvisit.assist_gate
  RouteField: use
  Facts: [{Name=assist_enabled, Variable=assist_enabled}, {Name=items, Variable=items}]
  InputNames: [assist_enabled, items]
step suggest
  Kind: Ai
  Stage: postvisit
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=check_suggestion}, {Label=onError, Target=physician_review}, {Label=onNotAvailable, Target=physician_review}, {Label=onInvalid, Target=physician_review}]
  Port: assist.suggest
  Retry: {MaxAttempts=2, Backoff=fixed, Initial=00:01:00}
  Inputs: [{Name=case, Variable=case_ref}, {Name=opportunities, Variable=opportunities}]
  Outputs: [{Name=code, Variable=suggested_code}, {Name=confidence, Variable=confidence}]
  InputNames: [case_ref, opportunities]
  OutputNames: [suggested_code, confidence]
  Model: model-a
  PromptId: coding-suggest
  PromptVersion: 1
  MaxAttempts: 2
  HasInputSchema: true
  HasOutputSchema: true
  InputSchemaJson: {"properties":{"case":{"type":"string"},"opportunities":{"type":"array"}},"required":["case","opportunities"],"type":"object"}
  OutputSchemaJson: {"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"code":{"pattern":"^C-[0-9]{3}$","type":"string"},"confidence":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["code"],"type":"object"}
step check_suggestion
  Kind: Decide
  Stage: postvisit
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=physician_review}, {Label=onNoDecision, Target=physician_review}, {Label=onError, Target=physician_review}]
  Rule: postvisit.suggestion_check
  Facts: [{Name=confidence, Variable=confidence}]
  Outputs: [{Name=usable, Variable=suggestion_usable}]
  InputNames: [confidence]
  OutputNames: [suggestion_usable]
step physician_review
  Kind: HumanTask
  Stage: postvisit
  Routes: [{Label=on:approved, Target=approved}, {Label=on:changed, Target=approved}, {Label=on:rejected, Target=rejected}]
  Queue: physician_review
  Outcomes: [approved, changed, rejected]
  Show: [case_ref, opportunities, suggested_code, confidence, suggestion_usable]
  Outputs: [{Name=code, Variable=final_code}]
  InputNames: [case_ref, opportunities, suggested_code, confidence, suggestion_usable]
  OutputNames: [final_code]
step approved
  Kind: End
  Stage: postvisit
  Result: coding_approved
step rejected
  Kind: End
  Stage: postvisit
  Result: coding_rejected
